name: Shanks
reason: Shanks' boat (canonical route in game/data/canonical/npcs/15.json, from the cached MeowDB beginner guide: Southperry 000000060 -> Lith Harbor 010000000, 300 mesos, level 7, one-way, 'Hand in every Maple Island quest before you board.') is the boundary of Iteration Three: Victoria Island is not in this build. Shanks offers the voyage and checks the canonical level and fare; when Maple Island quests are unfinished he warns with the guide's sentence and the character's list; on Yes the game shows an 'End of Maple Island' screen instead of sailing.

reasons.boundary: Lith Harbor and Victoria Island are out of scope (ITERATION_THREE_BRIEF.md: 'The Southperry departure boundary is enough'), so boarding ends at an end-of-island screen and the character stays in Southperry.
reasons.charge_fare: No voyage happens, so the canonical 300-meso fare is checked but not taken; the player keeps the mesos for when Victoria Island exists.
reasons.flag: Records that this character reached the departure boundary, with the game clock (Game.clock seconds, like quest timestamps), so a later build can offer the real voyage and a playthrough can check the boundary was reached.
reasons.unfinished_quests_region: The canonical quest records' region (game/data/canonical/quests/*.json "region"); the guide's advice names Maple Island quests.
